name: Graphic Design
heroSubtitle: Creative visual designs that bring your brand to life, communicate your message and leave a lasting impression.
shortDescription: We create professional graphic designs that help businesses and individuals communicate visually and build recognisable brands.
fullDescription: TOP TECH provides creative graphic design solutions for businesses, organisations, entrepreneurs and individuals. From brand identity and promotional materials to social media graphics and marketing designs, we combine creativity, visual consistency and clear communication to bring ideas to life. Every design is developed with your brand, audience and intended purpose in mind.

benefits.title: Consistent Brand Recognition
benefits.description: Unified colors, typography, and layout rules make every flyer, post, and invoice look unmistakably yours.

benefits.title: Print & Digital Precision
benefits.description: Assets are exported in crisp vector formats, CMYK print-ready PDFs, and high-DPI web formats.

benefits.title: Fast Campaign Turnaround
benefits.description: Reusable promotional templates let your marketing stay sharp across events, product drops, and announcements.

features.title: Vector Logo Construction
features.description: Clean geometric marks that scale sharply from favicons to storefront signage.

features.title: Brand Guidelines Document
features.description: Clear usage rules covering color palettes, font pairings, clear space, and light/dark lockups.

features.title: Marketing & Print Collateral
features.description: Brochures, event posters, flyers, business cards, letterheads, and pull-up banners.

features.title: Social Media Template Kits
features.description: Coordinated square, portrait, and cover layouts for Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and Facebook.

processSteps.title: Brand & Audience Brief
processSteps.description: We review your positioning, target audience, competitors, and visual preferences.

processSteps.title: Concept Exploration
processSteps.description: We present focused creative directions showing typography, color, and layout structure.

processSteps.title: Refinement & System Expansion
processSteps.description: We polish your selected direction and extend it across print and digital deliverables.

processSteps.title: Final File Package
processSteps.description: You receive organized SVG, PNG, PDF, and editable source files ready for printers and web teams.

faqs.question: What file formats do I receive for logo and print designs?
faqs.answer: You receive scalable vector files (SVG, PDF, EPS/AI), transparent high-resolution PNGs, and CMYK print-ready PDFs with proper bleed.

faqs.question: Can I order only flyers, posters, or social graphics without a full rebrand?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can book standalone promotional graphics or a full brand identity package.

faqs.question: How many revision rounds are included?
faqs.answer: Every project scope includes structured review and refinement rounds so the final artwork meets your expectations.

idealFor: New ventures building their brand from scratch and established companies refreshing campaign visuals.

seo.title: Graphic Design — TOP TECH
seo.description: Logo design, branding, flyers, posters, banners, and promotional graphics by TOP TECH.
